SELECT DISTINCT gender FROM
WHERE gender IS NOT NULL AND gender != '' ORDER BY gender ASC

SELECT DISTINCT platform_usage FROM
WHERE platform_usage IS NOT NULL AND platform_usage != '' ORDER BY platform_usage ASC

WHERE social_interaction_level IS NOT NULL AND social_interaction_level != '' ORDER BY social_interaction_level ASC

WHERE depression_label IS NOT NULL ORDER BY depression_label ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(age), 0), 2) AS avgAge, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(daily_social_media_hours), 0), 2) AS avgSocialHours, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(sleep_hours), 0), 2) AS avgSleepHours, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(screen_time_before_sleep), 0), 2) AS avgScreenBeforeSleep, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(academic_performance), 0), 2) AS avgAcademicPerformance, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(physical_activity), 0), 2) AS avgPhysicalActivity, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(stress_level), 0), 2) AS avgStress, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(anxiety_level), 0), 2) AS avgAnxiety, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(addiction_level), 0), 2) AS avgAddiction, SUM(CASE WHEN depression_label = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS riskCount, SUM(CASE WHEN depression_label = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normalCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN depression_label = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS riskRate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN daily_social_media_hours >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS highSocialUseRate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN sleep_hours < 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS sleepInsufficientRate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN stress_level >= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS highStressRate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN anxiety_level >= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS highAnxietyRate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN addiction_level >= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS highAddictionRate FROM

SELECT t.segmentKey, t.segmentName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.daily_social_media_hours), 0), 2) AS avgSocialHours, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.sleep_hours), 0), 2) AS avgSleepHours, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.academic_performance), 0), 2) AS avgAcademicPerformance, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.physical_activity), 0), 2) AS avgPhysicalActivity, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.stress_level), 0), 2) AS avgStress, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.anxiety_level), 0), 2) AS avgAnxiety, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.addiction_level), 0), 2) AS avgAddiction, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.depression_label = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS riskRate FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN age IS NULL THEN 99 WHEN age <= 12 THEN 1 WHEN age BETWEEN 13 AND 15 THEN 2 WHEN age BETWEEN 16 AND 18 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS segmentKey, CASE WHEN age IS NULL THEN '未知年龄' WHEN age <= 12 THEN '12岁及以下' WHEN age BETWEEN 13 AND 15 THEN '13-15岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 16 AND 18 THEN '16-18岁' ELSE '19岁及以上' END AS segmentName, daily_social_media_hours, sleep_hours, academic_performance, physical_activity, stress_level, anxiety_level, addiction_level, depression_label FROM
) t GROUP BY t.segmentKey, t.segmentName ORDER BY t.segmentKey ASC

SELECT t.segmentKey, t.segmentName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.daily_social_media_hours), 0), 2) AS avgSocialHours, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.sleep_hours), 0), 2) AS avgSleepHours, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.screen_time_before_sleep), 0), 2) AS avgScreenBeforeSleep, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.academic_performance), 0), 2) AS avgAcademicPerformance, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.stress_level), 0), 2) AS avgStress, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.anxiety_level), 0), 2) AS avgAnxiety, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.addiction_level), 0), 2) AS avgAddiction, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.depression_label = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS riskRate FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN daily_social_media_hours IS NULL THEN 99 WHEN daily_social_media_hours <= 1 THEN 1 WHEN daily_social_media_hours <= 3 THEN 2 WHEN daily_social_media_hours <= 5 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS segmentKey, CASE WHEN daily_social_media_hours IS NULL THEN '未知' WHEN daily_social_media_hours <= 1 THEN '1小时及以下' WHEN daily_social_media_hours <= 3 THEN '1-3小时' WHEN daily_social_media_hours <= 5 THEN '3-5小时' ELSE '5小时以上' END AS segmentName, daily_social_media_hours, sleep_hours, screen_time_before_sleep, academic_performance, stress_level, anxiety_level, addiction_level, depression_label FROM
) t GROUP BY t.segmentKey, t.segmentName ORDER BY t.segmentKey ASC

SELECT t.segmentKey, t.segmentName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.sleep_hours), 0), 2) AS avgSleepHours, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.daily_social_media_hours), 0), 2) AS avgSocialHours, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.screen_time_before_sleep), 0), 2) AS avgScreenBeforeSleep, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.academic_performance), 0), 2) AS avgAcademicPerformance, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.physical_activity), 0), 2) AS avgPhysicalActivity, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.stress_level), 0), 2) AS avgStress, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(t.anxiety_level), 0), 2) AS avgAnxiety, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.depression_label = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS riskRate FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN sleep_hours IS NULL THEN 99 WHEN sleep_hours < 6 THEN 1 WHEN sleep_hours < 7 THEN 2 WHEN sleep_hours < 8 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS segmentKey, CASE WHEN sleep_hours IS NULL THEN '未知' WHEN sleep_hours < 6 THEN '少于6小时' WHEN sleep_hours < 7 THEN '6-7小时' WHEN sleep_hours < 8 THEN '7-8小时' ELSE '8小时及以上' END AS segmentName, sleep_hours, daily_social_media_hours, screen_time_before_sleep, academic_performance, physical_activity, stress_level, anxiety_level, depression_label FROM
) t GROUP BY t.segmentKey, t.segmentName ORDER BY t.segmentKey ASC

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(social_interaction_level, ''), '未知') AS labelName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(daily_social_media_hours), 0), 2) AS avgSocialHours, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(sleep_hours), 0), 2) AS avgSleepHours, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(physical_activity), 0), 2) AS avgPhysicalActivity, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(academic_performance), 0), 2) AS avgAcademicPerformance, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(stress_level), 0), 2) AS avgStress, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(anxiety_level), 0), 2) AS avgAnxiety, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(addiction_level), 0), 2) AS avgAddiction, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN depression_label = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS riskRate FROM
GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(social_interaction_level, ''), '未知') ORDER BY totalCount DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN depression_label = 1 THEN '存在风险' WHEN depression_label = 0 THEN '暂无明显风险' ELSE '未知' END AS labelName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(LEAST(10, IFNULL(AVG(daily_social_media_hours), 0)), 2) AS socialMediaHours, ROUND(LEAST(10, IFNULL(AVG(screen_time_before_sleep), 0) * 1.5), 2) AS screenBeforeSleep, ROUND(LEAST(10, IFNULL(AVG(stress_level), 0)), 2) AS stressLevel, ROUND(LEAST(10, IFNULL(AVG(anxiety_level), 0)), 2) AS anxietyLevel, ROUND(LEAST(10, IFNULL(AVG(addiction_level), 0)), 2) AS addictionLevel, ROUND(CASE WHEN IFNULL(AVG(academic_performance), 0) > 10 THEN LEAST(10, IFNULL(AVG(academic_performance), 0) / 10) ELSE LEAST(10, IFNULL(AVG(academic_performance), 0)) END, 2) AS academicPerformanceScore, ROUND(LEAST(10, IFNULL(AVG(physical_activity), 0)), 2) AS physicalActivityScore, ROUND(LEAST(10, IFNULL(AVG(sleep_hours), 0)), 2) AS sleepHoursScore FROM
GROUP BY depression_label ORDER BY totalCount DESC

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(platform_usage, ''), '未知平台') AS labelName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(LEAST(10, IFNULL(AVG(daily_social_media_hours), 0)), 2) AS socialMediaHours, ROUND(LEAST(10, IFNULL(AVG(screen_time_before_sleep), 0) * 1.5), 2) AS screenBeforeSleep, ROUND(LEAST(10, IFNULL(AVG(stress_level), 0)), 2) AS stressLevel, ROUND(LEAST(10, IFNULL(AVG(anxiety_level), 0)), 2) AS anxietyLevel, ROUND(LEAST(10, IFNULL(AVG(addiction_level), 0)), 2) AS addictionLevel, ROUND(LEAST(10, IFNULL(AVG(sleep_hours), 0)), 2) AS sleepHoursScore, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN depression_label = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS riskRate FROM
GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(platform_usage, ''), '未知平台') ORDER BY totalCount DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT t.id, t.daily_social_media_hours AS socialHours, t.anxiety_level AS anxietyLevel, t.stress_level AS stressLevel, t.addiction_level AS addictionLevel, t.sleep_hours AS sleepHours, t.depression_label AS depressionLabel, IFNULL(NULLIF(t.platform_usage, ''), '未知平台') AS platformName FROM ( SELECT id, daily_social_media_hours, anxiety_level, stress_level, addiction_level, sleep_hours, depression_label, platform_usage FROM
) t WHERE t.daily_social_media_hours IS NOT NULL AND t.anxiety_level IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT t.id, t.screen_time_before_sleep AS screenBeforeSleep, t.sleep_hours AS sleepHours, t.stress_level AS stressLevel, t.depression_label AS depressionLabel, IFNULL(NULLIF(t.platform_usage, ''), '未知平台') AS platformName FROM ( SELECT id, screen_time_before_sleep, sleep_hours, stress_level, depression_label, platform_usage FROM
) t WHERE t.screen_time_before_sleep IS NOT NULL AND t.sleep_hours IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(platform_usage, ''), '未知平台') AS platformName, CASE WHEN depression_label = 1 THEN '存在风险' WHEN depression_label = 0 THEN '暂无明显风险' ELSE '未知' END AS riskName, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(stress_level), 0), 2) AS avgStress, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(anxiety_level), 0), 2) AS avgAnxiety FROM
GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(platform_usage, ''), '未知平台'), depression_label ORDER BY platformName ASC, riskName ASC
